card.architecture: Mage-Flow-Edit 4B native-resolution MMDiT (Mage-VAE + Qwen3-VL-4B encoder), 4-step distilled
card.summary: Few-step distilled Mage-Flow-Edit: 4 steps, cfg 1, ~1 s/edit at 1024x1024 on an A100. Fast instruction editing (background/style/add-remove/restoration) with 1-3 references; output follows the source size. No CFG / negative prompts.
card.pick_when: You want the fastest Mage-Flow edit -- 4-step instruction edits. Give up CFG/negative control for speed.

prompt.guidance: State what to KEEP, then what to CHANGE, in natural language (English recommended). Refer to attachments as 'the reference image'. Distilled: cfg 1, 4 steps, no negative.
prompt.example: Remove all the hot air balloons from the sky; keep everything else unchanged.
prompt.overview: The 4-step distilled Mage-Flow editor. Same instruction+reference prompting as the RL editor, but runs without classifier-free guidance -- do not supply a negative prompt.
prompt.instructions: Write the instruction as: what to keep, then what to change. English recommended. Attach 1-3 reference images and name what to take from each. Few-step distilled: 4 steps and cfg 1, no negative prompt. Output size follows the (resized ~1MP) reference.
do: Say what to keep, then what to change
Name what to take from each reference
dont: Supply a negative prompt (no effect at cfg 1)
Raise cfg above 1 or exceed 2048 px
prompt.negative_guidance: Runs without CFG (cfg 1); negative prompts have no effect.

ui_help.note: Say what to keep, then what to change -- like giving directions to an editor. Attach the picture(s) to work from.
ui_help.good_for: fast instruction edits: backgrounds, style, add/remove

edit_use_cases: fast instruction image editing (background replace, style/lighting, add/remove/recolour); 1-3 reference images

reference.hint: Describe the change and refer to an attached picture as 'the reference image'. Name what to take from it. You can attach up to three references.
